data.summary_en: Preregistered: GEPA, MIPROv2, TextGrad item-by-item checked unscored requirements on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, IFEval; rewriting prompts to improve target metrics broke output format. On HotpotQA, citation validity net regressed 10.7–41.6 points, exact match improved 21–34; post-hoc decomposition: under 200-token limit, 13.9%–47.0% answers ended before answer appeared.
